Figure 3: covariate-adjusted Cohen's d (FT - PT) with 95% CI per target ROI in neonates and adults.

- Input: `data/Figure3_input_adjusted_d.csv` (from `Revision_adjusted_effect_sizes.qmd`)
- Outputs (`outputs/figures`): `Revision_effect_size_longitudinal_CI2_ADJ<date>.png`, `Revision_effect_size_longitudinal_CI2_ADJ_doublecol_<date>.tif` (Figure 3)

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(here)

data_path <- here::here("data", "Figure3_input_adjusted_d.csv")
alpha     <- 0.05
type_levels <- c("Associative","Primary","Limbic")
```

```{r}
read_effect_csv <- function(path){
  first <- readLines(path, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  delim <- if (grepl(";", first)) ";" else if (grepl("\t", first)) "\t" else ","
  d <- readr::read_delim(path, delim = delim, show_col_types = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE)
  names(d) <- sub("^\\ufeff", "", names(d))
  names(d) <- trimws(names(d))
  d
}

df <- read_effect_csv(data_path)

required <- c("ROI","ROI_order","Type","BLS_d","BLS_p_FDR","dHCP_d","dHCP_p_FDR")
present  <- names(df)
missing  <- setdiff(required, present)

if (length(missing)) {
  stop(paste0(
    "These required columns were not found: ",
    paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
    "\nHeaders present: ",
    paste(present, collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

get_col <- function(d, nm) if (nm %in% names(d)) d[[nm]] else rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))

to_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  x <- as.character(x)
  use_comma <- sum(grepl(",", x, fixed = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE) >
               sum(grepl("\\.", x), na.rm = TRUE)
  readr::parse_number(x, locale = readr::locale(decimal_mark = if (use_comma) "," else "."))
}

num_cols <- c("ROI_order","BLS_d","BLS_p_FDR","BLS_ci_low","BLS_ci_high",
              "dHCP_d","dHCP_p_FDR","dHCP_ci_low","dHCP_ci_high")
num_cols <- intersect(num_cols, names(df))

df <- df |>
  mutate(across(all_of(num_cols), to_num))
```

```{r}
#| label: to-long-format

adults <- tibble(
  roi       = df$ROI,
  roi_order = df$ROI_order,
  type      = df$Type,
  cohort    = "Adults",
  cohen_d   = df$BLS_d,
  p         = df$BLS_p_FDR,
  ci_low    = get_col(df, "BLS_ci_low"),
  ci_high   = get_col(df, "BLS_ci_high")
)

neonates <- tibble(
  roi       = df$ROI,
  roi_order = df$ROI_order,
  type      = df$Type,
  cohort    = "Neonates",
  cohen_d   = df$dHCP_d,
  p         = df$dHCP_p_FDR,
  ci_low    = get_col(df, "dHCP_ci_low"),
  ci_high   = get_col(df, "dHCP_ci_high")
)

long <- bind_rows(adults, neonates) |>
  mutate(
    type = factor(type, levels = type_levels),
    sig  = if_else(p < alpha, "pFDR < 0.05", "NS"),
    roi  = fct_reorder(roi, roi_order, .desc = FALSE)
  )

long <- long %>%
  mutate(label = if ("ROI_label" %in% names(df)) df$ROI_label[match(roi, df$ROI)] else roi) %>%
  mutate(label = forcats::fct_reorder(label, roi_order, .desc = FALSE))
```

### Make figure

```{r}
long <- long %>%
  arrange(type, roi_order) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = unique(label)),
         y_id  = as.integer(label))

band_h <- 0.18

p4 <- ggplot(long, aes(x = cohen_d, y = y_id)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = subset(long, !is.na(ci_low) & !is.na(ci_high)),
    aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high,
        ymin = y_id - band_h, ymax = y_id + band_h, fill = cohort),
    alpha = 0.2, color = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group = roi), color = "gray70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = cohort, shape = sig), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Adults" = "#399AB5", "Neonates" = "#E06B0A")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adults" = "#399AB5", "Neonates" = "#E06B0A")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("pFDR < 0.05" = 16, "NS" = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(long$y_id)),
    labels = levels(long$label),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  facet_grid(type ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 1)) +
  theme_light(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, lineheight = 0.95)) +
  labs(
    x = "Cohen's d (FT vs PT)",
    y = "Region of Interest",
    color = "Cohort",
    shape = paste0("Significance")
  )
```

```{r}
outfile4 <- file.path(here::here("outputs","figures"),
                     paste0("Revision_effect_size_longitudinal_CI2_ADJ", format(Sys.Date()), ".png"))
ggsave(outfile4, plot = p4, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

### Save as TIFF (double column)

```{r}
outfile4_double <- file.path(here::here("outputs","figures"),
                     paste0("Revision_effect_size_longitudinal_CI2_ADJ_doublecol_",
                            format(Sys.Date()), ".tif"))
ggsave(outfile4_double, plot = p4,
       width = 185, height = 144, units = "mm", dpi = 300,
```
